examples.text: Era calmo in presenza del pericolo.
examples.en: He was calm in the presence of danger.

examples.text: Non ero conscio della sua presenza.
examples.en: I was not conscious of his presence.

examples.text: La tua presenza qui significa molto per me.
examples.en: Your being here means a lot to me.
He seemed unconscious of my presence.

examples.text: Divento sempre nervoso in sua presenza.
examples.en: I always get nervous in her presence.
